 Jess Anderson
 Show Most recent Most popular Post published at 79 mins 79 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Neco Williams is on the floor holding his ribs behind the goal line after a coming together with Daizen Maeda.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 77 mins 77 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 James McAtee has a go from range. It bounces awkwardly in front of Christian Walton, no doubt in no small part thanks to the weather, and he has to fall on the ball to make sure it's in his grasp.
 51 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 76 mins 76 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Oh how Liam Delap would like to score against his former side.
 He's had three shots in the game but none of them have been on target.
 63 42 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:35 BST 21:35 BST 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Lee Hendrie 
Former Aston Villa midfielder on Sky Sports 
 Delap could just not get the whip on the ball. I can't believe he didn't score then. 
 39 41 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 75 mins 75 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 A whipped ball into the box and Liam Delap misses the initial touch but he has a second bite of the cherry and his header goes over the bar.
 More "wheyyy" chants from the home supporters as Delap hits another one wide seconds later.
 65 31 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 73 mins 73 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Abdul Fatawu makes way for Daizen Maeda for the hosts.
 62 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:30 BST 21:30 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 The fact that opinion on the red card is split indicates it was not an obvious goal scoring opportunity. The line has to be drawn somewhere on what is obvious. Im OK with leaving that one to the referee.
 Andrew, London 
 269 166 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 69 mins 69 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 A change for Forest.
 Dan Ndoye makes way for Callum Hudson-Odoi.
 165 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:26 BST 21:26 BST 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Lee Hendrie 
Former Aston Villa midfielder on Sky Sports 
 Image source, Getty Images Ipswich are causing their own problems by giving the ball away cheaply. 
 That big toe of the Ipswich goalkeeper Christian Walton has had a big impact this evening. Forest will feel they should have scored. 
 101 42 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 65 mins 65 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Howwww have Forest not scored?!
 Ipswich lose the ball cheaply in the middle of the park and the visitors pile forward.
 It comes to Dan Ndoye on the left and his shot back across the face of goal looks certain to find the bottom corner but it's another crucial intervention on the line from Leif Davies.
 156 80 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 63 mins 63 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Another Forest corner and another big opportunity for Murillo.
 The corner comes to him but his header drops just wide.
 Big chance.
 106 45 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:21 BST 21:21 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 At last a ref has the courage to go to the monitor and not go with the decision he is being urged by VAR officials to make, and it gets thumbed down here. Seems like all fans want to do is moan.
 Cameron, Kanas City 
 426 362 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 61 mins 61 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Gary O'Neil turns to his bench.
 Jack Clarke and Zian Fleming are on for Jaden Philogene and Emersonn.
 87 19 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 60 mins 60 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Forest win back-to-back corners.
 The second comes to Neco Williams but his effort is blocked. Murillo tries to bend one in but Christian Walton punches away.
 98 26 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 56 mins 56 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Risky from Christian Walton as he passes out from the back but just about gets away with it.
 Someone needs to get hold of this game, there are opportunities for both sides to score.
 87 15 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:14 BST 21:14 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 Deary me. That’s such a red card. Is Bramall saying he couldn’t get a shot off from a slight angle? I will always be pro-VAR but it really needs work doing to it.
 Tom, Widnes 
 371 171 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 54 mins 54 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 That incident has really fired things up.
 Murillo goes into the book for a foul on Emersonn.
 93 107 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Should have been red' published at 21:12 BST 21:12 BST 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Lee Hendrie 
Former Aston Villa midfielder on Sky Sports 
 Image source, Getty Images I do feel that Issa Diop is lucky he has got away with that. I think it should have been a red card. 
 440 213 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 52 mins 52 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 A controversial decision.
 Thomas Bramall says that James McAtee takes a touch to take the ball away from goal. If he does, it's only a very small one.
 Ipswich still have XI on the pitch. On we go.
 157 264 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 NO RED CARD published at 51 mins 51 mins 
 Ipswich 1-1 Nottm Forest 
 Referee Thomas Bramall has a good long look at the monitor but he opts for a booking and a free-kick.
 He explains they feel James McAtee was going away from goal.
